texts.label: text
texts.orig: This document is the simplest possible fixture: a single toplevel heading, two sub-headings, and a handful of plain paragraphs. It exists to prove the extraction adapter's twopass ref-resolution graph builder works at all before layering on anything more complex, and that heading levels are mapped correctly.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The first attempt at this fixture was too short for docling's layout model to tell the heading levels apart - every heading came back as level one regardless of whether it was an h1, h2, or h3 in the source. This revision leans on more real body text per section instead of hand-tuned CSS font sizes, on the theory that the model needs more document context to establish a relative scale between heading levels.
